about: Examples `threedog examples list|pull` can copy into a game. The single list: a folder under examples/ is pullable only when it is named here. Summary = the first line of its README.md. files = the game-facing files (the demo page and its main.js stay here). use = the line to print after a pull, paths relative to the pulled folder.

contact-shadows.use: import { applyContactShadows, groundStatic } from './contactShadows.js';  applyContactShadows(engine, { sun, hemi });  // your own three.js lights

day-night-grade.use: import { createPicture } from './picture/index.js';  const picture = createPicture(engine);  // createEngine({ lights: false }); shapes take picture.mat.<name>, picture.addLamp(x, y, z)

interior-light.use: import { exposureZones, windowLight } from './interiorLight.js';  const zones = exposureZones(engine, { hemi, isInside, exposure, ambient });  engine.onFrame(dt => zones.update(dt));  windowLight(engine, { position, lookAt, width, height });

modular-building.use: import { createModularKit } from './kit.js';  const kit = createModularKit({ slots: { wall: yourWallMaterial } });  engine.assets.manifest(kit.pack);

night-lights.use: import { createNightLights } from './nightLights.js';  engine.use(lightPool({ spot: 8 }));  const lights = createNightLights(engine);  lights.addLamp(position, { head: headMaterial });  lights.addGlow(windowMaterial);

outlines-and-rim.use: import { trackResolution, addHull, rimPatch } from './outlines.js';  // see README for which route fits your DESIGN.md

procedural-animation.use: import { createProceduralAnimator, KNOBS } from './proceduralAnim.js';  const anim = createProceduralAnimator({ body, legs, tail }); // update it in onFrame (README)

procedural-surface.use: import { scaleForCamera, worldVariation, brushTexture, cavity } from './surface.js';  // see README for which route fits your DESIGN.md

rc2d.use: import { createRadianceCascades2D } from './rc2d.js';  const rc = createRadianceCascades2D(engine, { layer: 5, ambient: 0.15 });  // then put rc.pass in your post chain before the tone curve (README)

stylized-shading.use: import { rampTexture, toonMaterial, toonPatch, painterlyMaterial } from './shading.js';  // see README for which route fits your DESIGN.md

sun-and-key-light.use: import { applyKeyFill, aimSun, fitSunShadow } from './keyLight.js';  applyKeyFill({ sun, hemi, scene }, route);  aimSun(sun, { elevation, azimuth, camera });  fitSunShadow(sun, { extent });  // your own three.js lights

three-looks.use: import { createPicture } from './picture/index.js';  const { materials } = createPicture(engine, 'comic');  // materials by part name; lights, fog and post are set up

webgpu-tsl.use: import 'threedog/tsl';  import { createPicture } from './picture/index.js';  const picture = createPicture(engine);  // createEngine({ renderer: 'webgpu', lights: false }); shapes take picture.mat.ground, picture.mat.grass, picture.mat.lantern
